generate_attention_matrix_from_mask: generate a colored attention matrix from a mask tensor with sliding window and image token support
create_AttentionMaskVisualizer: create an AttentionMaskVisualizer instance for a given HuggingFace model name to inspect attention patterns
visualize_AttentionMaskVisualizer: visualize the attention mask for a sentence using an AttentionMaskVisualizer instance
call_AttentionMaskVisualizer: call an AttentionMaskVisualizer instance directly with a sentence to print its attention matrix
review_attention_visualizer: review the attention_visualizer module that generates terminal-based attention matrix visualizations for transformer models
